At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce.

From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes.

Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?
Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane , and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane —a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable .
Our mission is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents . We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.
Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across 100+ countries . Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide . We’re a Series B company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital , and we’ve raised $69M to date. Learn more at upbound.io
As a Business Development Representative at Upbound , you will own early-stage pipeline generation and serve as the first touchpoint in the sales cycle. You’ll play a critical role in growing our pipeline by engaging high-intent prospects who have shown interest in Crossplane , while also sourcing and developing new opportunities through targeted outbound efforts.
In this role, you will qualify inbound leads, execute focused outbound outreach, and set up high-quality discovery conversations for the sales team. You’ll build meaningful relationships within the community, research and engage target accounts, and support events, sales operations, and special projects.

Serving as a key bridge between Marketing and Sales , your primary mission is to generate qualified pipeline and help fuel Upbound’s growth. You will report directly to the Head of BDR and work closely with both the Sales and Marketing teams.

Establish and maintain a collaborative, strategic partnership with the assigned AE’s.
Engage marketing-qualified leads, event attendees, and high-intent prospects through thoughtful, multi-channel outreach.
Target prospects through research and personalization using email, phone, LinkedIn, Slack communities, and other channels.
Research accounts within defined segments and verticals to identify target personas and generate sales-qualified leads.
Book qualified meetings with IT, engineering, and executive stakeholders for the Account Executives you support.
Have meaningful discovery conversations to understand prospect challenges and articulate the value of Crossplane and Upbound.
Outbound and source your own leads through various channels using research and creatively to book meetings.

A Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
1–2 years of experience in sales, marketing, or a related role.
Comfort operating in a technical environment; open source and/or infrastructure exposure is strongly preferred.
Hunter mentality, resourcefulness, and self-starter.
A genuine interest in building relationships, networking, and starting conversations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience using sales and marketing tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Marketo, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

You’re familiar with Crossplane and/or Upbound
Familiarity with CNCF or other open source cloud-native projects.
You’ve worked at a Series A, B or C startup

Why Upbound?
At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.
About Upbound
Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries.

The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents.

Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date.

For more information, visit www.upbound.io .

Remote Business Development Representative Job Description About emagineHealth emagineHealth is a full-service marketing agency built exclusively for the life sciences industry. For more than 30 years, we have served pharma, biotech, medical device, diagnostics, and drug development services companies.

We are a team of approximately 50 people who show up every day to help the companies advancing health and wellbeing worldwide tell better stories and build stronger commercial functions. The Role We are looking for a Business Development Representative who thinks like a marketer and sells like a strategist.

This person will own the new business pipeline, from prospecting through close, and will be the external face of everything we are building at emagineHealth.

We are hiring someone who genuinely understands the way marketing creates commercial value in the life sciences, who can diagnose a client's challenge before they even articulate it, and who can walk into a room of senior decision-makers and credibly represent the thinking behind our approach.

If you have run marketing at a life sciences agency, or served as a marketing strategist and then moved into sales, you are exactly who we are describing. The industry knowledge is a bonus. The marketing knowledge and consultative sales approach is non-negotiable. Responsibilities This is an autonomous role. You run your own pipeline.

You are responsible for outreach, discovery, proposal development, and close. You will work closely with the VP of Commercial Strategy on deal strategy, with the account management team on handoffs, and with our management team on crafting pitches.

Day-to-day, that looks like: Building and managing a qualified pipeline of life sciences prospects (CDMOs, CROs, biotech, pharma, med device, diagnostics, and eClinical companies), targeting marketing and commercial decision-makers at the VP and C-suite level Running discovery calls that actually uncover the client's business problem, not just their project list.

You diagnose before you prescribe. Leading proposal and pitch development in partnership with the VP of Commercial Strategy. You do not just oversee the deck, you shape the narrative. You know why the story matters, not just how to build the slides.

Managing 3 to 9 month deal cycles across multiple stakeholders (marketing, BD, commercial leadership, procurement, medical affairs, etc.). You know how to navigate a buying committee. Identifying expansion opportunities within the sales process. You can see a broader AOR relationship where a client initially sees a single project.

Maintaining CRM hygiene and providing accurate pipeline forecasting. You own your numbers. Representing emagineHealth at industry conferences (CPHI, BIO, SCOPE, and others) with the goal of building a network of executives who already know us before they need us. Acting as the internal bridge between market intelligence and service delivery.

You surface what you are hearing in the market and you bring that back to the team so our capabilities stay aligned with what buyers actually need. Who We Are Looking For There is a profile of a person that will succeed here and a profile of person that will not. We are being direct about both.

Marketing Foundation: You understand how marketing works. You have either run marketing programs yourself or you have sat close enough to the strategy side that you can speak to brand positioning, digital channels, content strategy, and why the website matters before you even think about paid media.

Sales Instinct: You know how to qualify fast, follow up without being annoying, read a room, and push a deal forward without pushing the prospect away. You understand that consultative selling in a relationship-driven industry like life sciences is a long game and you have the patience and the discipline for it.

Autonomy: You do not need hand holding. You figure things out. When you hit an obstacle, you first try to brainstorm a solution and then consult others. Agency life is fast and sometimes ambiguous, and you are comfortable in that environment. You build your own structure where structure does not yet exist. Speed: This is an agency.

Response time matters. Follow-through matters. You are someone who moves quickly, keeps commitments, and makes it easy for people to work with you. Commercial Intelligence: You understand pricing, margins, and what makes a deal actually profitable.

You understand that the deals you bring in affect the financial health of the organization, and you take that seriously. Executive Presence: You can hold a room. You are comfortable presenting to CMOs, VPs of Commercial, and founders who have strong opinions. You do not shrink when challenged.

You come prepared, and when you do not know something, you say so and get back to them. Industry Experience Life sciences experience is strongly preferred. If you have worked in pharma, biotech, CRO, CDMO, or adjacent sectors (either in-house or at an agency serving those clients), you are ahead of the curve.

If you do not have deep life sciences experience but have a strong marketing and sales background within B2B clients, let’s have a serious conversation. The industry can be learned. The mindset cannot. What Success Looks Like in Year One A qualified pipeline is built and actively moving.

You are running multiple deals at different stages simultaneously. You have attended at least one major industry conference and have meaningful new relationships to show for it. You met or exceeded your Quota. The VP of Commercial Strategy trusts you to run deals independently and looks to you as a thought partner on pipeline strategy.

The internal team sees you as a partner, not someone who overpromises during the sale and underdelivers at kickoff. You have contributed at least one piece of market intelligence that has meaningfully shaped our positioning or service approach.

Perks of Joining the emagine Team Opportunity to collaboratively work with top-tier talent A “family-like” environment will make you feel at home from your first day No micromanaging or breathing down your neck A culture of trust, appreciation for one another, and respect A company that recognizes that work can’t always be fun, but strives every day to keep it fun and enjoyable On the job training and development Medical and Dental insurance 401(k) with match Graduated PTO/Vacation Policy Professional Development reimbursement Employee referral incentive “HeyTaco” app on Slack allows employees to give thanks, praise and accolades to coworkers and cashed in for rewards or donated to charity Competitive salary Fitness/Wellness Reimbursement Paid vacation Personal days Opportunity to give back to the community **U.S. based applications only please.

At Ecolab, we help make the world cleaner, safer and healthier .
Ecolab is a trusted partner at nearly three million customer locations in more than 170 countries and a global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions. We combine complete solutions, data‑driven insights and personalised service to help customers improve food safety, maintain safe environments, optimise water and energy use, and drive sustainable performance across food, healthcare, hospitality and industrial sectors.
If you are early in your career and looking to learn, grow and make a real impact, our Territory Manager in Training Programme could be the right next step.
About the Programme
This is a 12 month, structured development programme designed to prepare you for a future role as a Territory Manager. Starting from October 1st, 2026 you will be supported every step of the way through a combination of:
Classroom and virtual learning
On‑the‑job training and job shadowing
Coaching from experienced colleagues
Hands‑on experience with customers in real environments
From day one you’ll gain exposure to customer operations, learn how to diagnose challenges, and develop practical solutions that improve safety, hygiene and sustainability.
About the Division
Within the Water division (Nalco Water, an Ecolab company), Ecolab delivers water treatment, process and digital water management solutions to help customers improve operational performance, protect critical assets and advance sustainability goals. Our solutions support customers across industrial, manufacturing, food and beverage processing, power generation, energy, mining, data-centers and commercial facilities, from water intake through reuse and discharge.

After completing your training, you will take ownership of an established customer territory, becoming a trusted partner and technical advisor to your customers. You will provide expert guidance on water treatment, process optimisation and digital water management programs that help improve operational performance, protect critical assets and support safe, efficient and sustainable customer operations.

Build strong, trusted relationships with existing customers through regular service visits
Learn how customers’ systems work, gaining hands-on experience with equipment, technologies and solutions used in their daily operations
Support the installation, maintenance and safe use of equipment, helping customers keep their facilities fully operational
Train and support customer teams, making sure they feel confident using Ecolab solutions
Gradually develop the ability to spot improvement opportunities, deliver technical demonstrations and support the growth of your assigned territory
Work closely with colleagues across different teams (Sales, Marketing Services, Customer Service) to deliver the best possible customer experience
Contribute to Ecolab’s growth by supporting outreach activities and helping build our brand in your local market
What you’ll need?
We are interested in meeting individuals with diverse backgrounds. You may be a great fit if you:
Have completed technical / scientific education (Ideally in Chemical Engineering or Chemistry)
Are interested in building a career in technical, sales or service-related roles

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated people? And are you curious or passionate about sales?

SetSales is Northern Europe’s leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.
SetSales is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.

You will play a key role in helping us build some of the world's leading business conferences by bringing the right people into the room.
We will give you the training, tools and responsibility to succeed while continuously challenging you to develop your commercial skills and accelerate your career.
You’ll be based out of our HQ in London, where you will work alongside an ambitious and entrepreneurial team.
Uncapped earning potential: A competitive base salary and attractive commission structure where your results directly impact your earnings.
Rapid development: An opportunity to build exceptional sales skills in a high-performance environment with continuous coaching and feedback.
International exposure: Speak every day with senior executives, investors and business leaders from companies around the world.
International travel: The opportunity to attend our conferences and see first-hand the events and communities you help build.
Unlimited growth potential: We strongly believe in promoting internally and have a track record of giving exceptional performers significant responsibility early in their careers.

Your mission will be to drive revenue by selling delegate passes to senior professionals attending United Media's international conferences.
Your responsibilities will vary; however, some of them will be to:
Drive new business revenue: Proactively reach out to prospective delegates and convert them into paying attendees across our portfolio of conferences.
Own your sales targets: Take responsibility for ambitious monthly revenue targets and consistently work towards exceeding them.
Execute high-volume outreach: Work within a fast-paced outbound sales environment, making 60+ calls per day and creating approximately 10 qualified sales opportunities or proposals.
Own your pipeline: Manage prospects from first conversation through follow-up, proposal and close, ensuring opportunities continue to move forward.
Become an expert: Develop a strong understanding of our conferences, audiences and industries so you can confidently communicate why the right people should be in the room.
Collaborate across teams: Work closely with our marketing, content and conference teams to continuously improve our campaigns and the experience we offer delegates.
What we expect from you
You have a strong work ethic, a high sense of urgency and a genuine desire to succeed. You enjoy competing against ambitious targets, take ownership of your results and are motivated by seeing your own performance improve.
Most importantly, you want to sell . You enjoy the chase, the conversation and the feeling of turning an opportunity into a closed deal.
Drive & ambition: You are highly motivated, competitive and want to be exceptional at what you do.
Commercial mindset: You are excited by targets, revenue and the opportunity to directly influence your earnings through your performance.
Resilience: You are comfortable with a high level of outbound activity and have the persistence to keep going when you hear "no".
Communication: You are confident speaking with new people and can communicate professionally and persuasively over the phone and in writing.
Relationship building: You are genuinely curious about people and able to build rapport quickly with senior professionals.
Organisation: You can prioritise effectively and stay on top of a large number of prospects, conversations and follow-ups.
Growth mindset: You actively seek feedback and continuously look for ways to improve your performance.
Winning mentality: Whether demonstrated through sales, academics, competitive sports, entrepreneurship or another environment, you have evidence of setting ambitious goals and pushing yourself to achieve them.
Previous sales experience is an advantage but not a requirement . We are equally interested in exceptional graduates and early-career candidates who can demonstrate the drive, communication skills and competitive mindset needed to build a successful career in sales.
Start date: Flexible.
Monday–Friday we work from our office next to Sloane Square Station. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.

About Revelo
Revelo provides top quality tech talent from Latin American countries to US and Canadian companies hiring remotely.
We are a tech first company that uses our technology to source, match and allocate remote digital workers faster, cheaper and more accurately than competitors. We are in the middle of the biggest shift to remote work that the world has ever seen - come be a part of it!
With large amounts of capital being injected into Brazil and Latin America over the previous 15 years from both national and international venture capital and capital equity, there has been a significant increase in the education of professionals and adolescents with skills in all aspects of technology (software development, data science, product development, product management, crypto, and so forth).

This rapid growth of maturing companies has made Latin America a key producer of high caliber tech talent. The pandemic opened the eyes of North American companies to the opportunity of accessing that talent for a new pool of candidates beyond the saturated and more competitive markets they’re used to recruiting in.
Born in 2015 out of São Paulo, over the course of 8 years we’ve gained vast expertise in sourcing, recruiting and placing tech talent throughout Latin America. We’re now able to share that knowledge and help companies connect to the right talent to build their technology.

Job Description

The Strategic Business Development Advisor is responsible for developing and executing territory and account engagement strategies that expand Galvanize's presence within Enterprise and Government markets.

This role exercises independent judgment in identifying market opportunities, prioritizing target accounts, developing prospect engagement strategies, qualifying business opportunities, and advising internal stakeholders on market trends, customer needs, and pipeline development.

The position collaborates closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, and Strategic Account Advisors to optimize business development initiatives and improve sales effectiveness.

Strategic Pipeline Development
Develop and execute territory-specific prospecting and account engagement strategies aligned with organizational revenue objectives.
Analyze target markets, industry trends, customer initiatives, competitive activity, and organizational priorities to identify high-value business opportunities.
Determine outreach priorities and engagement approaches based on independent assessment of account potential, buying readiness, and strategic fit.
Design and adapt multi-channel engagement strategies utilizing email, phone, LinkedIn, referrals, events, and other approved business development channels.
Evaluate campaign effectiveness and modify outreach strategies to improve engagement and conversion rates.
Business Opportunity Assessment
Conduct consultative discovery conversations to evaluate organizational priorities, workforce challenges, AI initiatives, budget considerations, and strategic objectives.
Exercise independent judgment in determining opportunity qualification, sales readiness, stakeholder alignment, and appropriate next steps.
Identify business risks, obstacles, and competitive considerations while recommending strategies to advance opportunities.
Develop account intelligence and strategic recommendations that enable successful engagement by Strategic Account Advisors.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Serve as a strategic partner to Sales Leadership by providing market intelligence, customer feedback, and recommendations for improving business development effectiveness.
Collaborate with Marketing to refine messaging, campaign strategy, and target audience segmentation.
Recommend improvements to business development processes, sales workflows, qualification methodology, and CRM utilization.
Participate in planning discussions regarding territory development, market expansion, and pipeline forecasting.
Pipeline Management & Business Analysis
Maintain responsibility for the quality, health, and strategic direction of assigned business development pipeline.
Analyze pipeline performance, conversion metrics, and engagement effectiveness to identify trends and recommend corrective actions.
Prepare reports and communicate market observations, business risks, opportunity forecasts, and pipeline insights to leadership.
Ensure CRM records accurately reflect strategic account information, customer needs, opportunity status, and recommended actions.

3+ years of experience in business development, strategic sales, account development, consultative sales, recruiting, or a related client-facing business role.
Demonstrated ability to independently prioritize work, manage territory strategy, and exercise sound business judgment.
Experience analyzing customer organizations and developing strategic engagement plans.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging to executive and senior leadership audiences.
Experience using CRM systems, sales engagement platforms, and business productivity software.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing multiple priorities and competing business objectives.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Experience developing Enterprise or Government accounts.
Knowledge of public-sector procurement, workforce development, professional services, or technology solutions.
Understanding of AI adoption, workforce transformation, and organizational change initiatives.
Experience collaborating across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success functions.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Pour renforcer notre équipe de Fribourg, nous recherchons une personne capable d'allier qualité du coaching, compréhension du monde du travail, capacité d'analyse et cadre professionnel.
### Votre mission: ###
· Accompagner un retour au travail, ce qui ne consiste pas simplement à aider quelqu'un à trouver un emploi
· Aider une personne à retrouver progressivement une capacité à fonctionner dans un environnement professionnel, à identifier ses ressources et ses limites, à reconstruire des repères et à développer une manière de travailler qui soit à la fois réaliste et durable
· Allier qualité du coaching, compréhension du monde du travail, capacité d'analyse et cadre professionnel
· Soutenir sans faire à la place et encourager l'autonomie et permettre à chacun de progresser, d'expérimenter et d'apprendre de ses erreurs
· Être empathique sans perdre le cadre professionnel et écouter et comprendre les difficultés tout en gardant le focus sur les possibilités et les objectifs
· Observer avant d'interpréter et distinguer clairement les faits, les observations et les hypothèses afin de poser des constats objectifs et utiles aux décisions de réadaptation
· Comprendre le monde du travail réel et tenir compte à la fois de la personne et de son environnement professionnel, des exigences du poste, des relations de travail et des attentes de l'employeur
· Être à l'aise avec la complexité et adapter l'accompagnement à des parcours parfois non linéaires, tout en gardant les objectifs de réentrainement ligne de mire en partageant les observations et les connaissances, confronter les points de vue et solliciter un autre regard lorsque la situation le nécessite
### Votre responsabilités: ###
Vous serez responsable de l'accompagnement individuel d'un portefeuille de participants tout au long de leur mesure de réadaptation. Concrètement, vous :
· conduisez des coachings individuels réguliers et définissez avec chaque participant des objectifs de progression concrets
· observez et analysez les capacités fonctionnelles dans un contexte professionnel: organisation, rythme, autonomie, communication, gestion de la charge, interactions sociales et capacité d'adaptation
· accompagnez le développement progressif de l'autonomie et de la capacité de travail
· aidez les participants à clarifier leur projet professionnel et à préparer leur retour vers le premier marché du travail
· identifiez avec eux des opportunités de mises en situation, missions ou stages auprès d'entreprises
· animez des workshops et des journées de formation en groupe
· contribuez à créer un environnement de réentraînement qui se rapproche du fonctionnement réel d'une entreprise, tout en respectant les objectifs et les limites de la mesure
· collaborez étroitement avec les conseillers AI, professionnels de santé, employeurs et autres partenaires impliqués, et notamment lors de séances réseau
· rédigez des rapports structurés, factuels et utiles à la prise de décision
· documentez les observations et étapes importantes du parcours dans nos outils internes
· participez activement à la vie de l'équipe et à l'amélioration continue de notre programme
### Votre profil: ###
Nous cherchons un-e professionnel-le expérimenté-e de l'accompagnement et du monde du travail, capable de créer une relation de confiance tout en maintenant un cadre clair. Vous disposez idéalement :
· de plusieurs années d'expérience en coaching (ou psychologie), en insertion/réinsertion professionnelle, case management, orientation professionnelle, ressources humaines ou accompagnement de carrière
· d'une formation reconnue en coaching (ICF ou formation comparable) ou d'une formation pertinente dans le domaine de l'accompagnement professionnel ;
· d'une bonne connaissance du marché du travail suisse
· d'une connaissance du système suisse des assurances sociales et de l'Assurance-invalidité ou d'une réelle capacité à en apprendre rapidement les mécanismes
· d'une expérience dans l'animation de groupes, de workshops ou de formations
· d'une bonne maîtrise des outils numériques usuels, notamment Microsoft 365
· Une expérience directe avec l'AI, les mesures de réadaptation professionnelle ou le case management constitue un réel avantage
· d'une excellente maîtrise du français, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. De bonnes connaissances professionnelles de l'allemand et de l'anglais constituent un atout
### Notre offre: ###
Vous rejoignez une équipe qui travaille au croisement du coaching, de la réadaptation professionnelle, de la formation et du marché du travail. Vous bénéficierez :
· d'une grande autonomie dans l'organisation de vos accompagnements
· d'un cadre méthodologique et d'outils structurés
· d'échanges réguliers et de partage de pratiques au sein de l'équipe
· de situations professionnelles riches et variées
· de la possibilité de contribuer activement à l'évolution du programme et de nos pratiques
· d'un environnement dans lequel la qualité de l'accompagnement, la collaboration et la responsabilité professionnelle occupent une place centrale
· d'un poste permanent entre 80 et 100% à Fribourg
Postuler chez InnoPark - avec l'envie de faire bouger les choses, nous attendons ta candidature en ligne complète, et quelques lignes expliquant ce qui vous intéresse particulièrement dans l'accompagnement de personnes en réadaptation professionnelle en précisant ta date de disponibilité ainsi que tes prétentions salariales. Nous nous réjouissons de découvrir votre parcours.
